package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema = "student-practice-learning-action-reserve.v1"
	StudentPracticeLearningActionOpenSchema    = "student-practice-learning-action-open.v1"
	StudentPracticeLearningActionCancelSchema  = "student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1"
	StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema = "student-practice-learning-action-binding.v1"
	PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2         = "practice-task-competency-evidence.v2"
	PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV2            = "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2"
	PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2         = "practice-competency-evidence-v2"
	PracticeLearningActionCancelReason         = "practice_provisioning_failed"
	PracticeLearningActionStudentCancelReason  = "student_cancelled"
)

type PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus string

const (
	PracticeLearningActionReserved  PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus = "RESERVED"
	PracticeLearningActionOpen      PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus = "OPEN"
	PracticeLearningActionCancelled PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus = "CANCELLED"
	PracticeLearningActionClosed    PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus = "CLOSED"
)

func IsPracticeLearningActionCancelReason(reason string) bool {
	return reason == PracticeLearningActionCancelReason || reason == PracticeLearningActionStudentCancelReason
}

func CanCancelPracticeLearningAction(status PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus, reason string) bool {
	switch reason {
	case PracticeLearningActionCancelReason:
		return status == PracticeLearningActionReserved
	case PracticeLearningActionStudentCancelReason:
		return status == PracticeLearningActionReserved || status == PracticeLearningActionOpen
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// PracticeLearningActionBinding is the Student-owned binding only. It carries
// no Practice runtime result, evaluation data, fixtures, or solution material.
type PracticeLearningActionBinding struct {
	LearningPathItemID              string                                `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID                   string                                `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	Schema                          string                                `json:"schema"`
	LearningActionID                string                                `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID                       string                                `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID                  string                                `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID                  string                                `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest              string                                `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	SurfaceClassification           string                                `json:"surface_classification"`
	LearningTargets                 []LearningTargetRef                   `json:"learning_targets"`
	LifecycleStatus                 PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	LearningPathID                  string                                `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathVersionReservation  int64                                 `json:"learning_path_version_at_reservation,omitempty"`
	LearningPathPositionReservation int                                   `json:"learning_path_position_at_reservation,omitempty"`
	OpenedAt                        *time.Time                            `json:"opened_at,omitempty"`
	ClosedAt                        *time.Time                            `json:"closed_at,omitempty"`
	CancelReason                    string                                `json:"cancel_reason,omitempty"`
	EnsureRequestHash               string                                `json:"-"`
}

type PracticeLearningActionReserve struct {
	LearningPathItemID       string              `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID            string              `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	Schema                   string              `json:"schema"`
	StudentID                string              `json:"-"`
	TaskInstanceID           string              `json:"-"`
	TaskRevisionID           string              `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest       string              `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	SurfaceClassification    string              `json:"surface_classification"`
	LearningTargets          []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
	LearningPathID           string              `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	IdempotencyKey           string              `json:"-"`
	LearningActionID         string              `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
	LearningActionIDExplicit bool                `json:"-"`
	EnsureRequestHash        string              `json:"-"`
	OccurredAt               time.Time           `json:"-"`
}

func NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(input PracticeLearningActionReserve) (PracticeLearningActionReserve, error) {
	if !validLessonCorrelationPair(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.LearningPathItemID != "" && input.LearningPathID == "" {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest)
	input.SurfaceClassification = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SurfaceClassification))
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	if input.IdempotencyKey != strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey) {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()
	if input.Schema != StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		input.IdempotencyKey != input.TaskInstanceID || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.LearningActionID) ||
		input.LearningActionID == input.TaskInstanceID || input.LearningActionID == input.TaskRevisionID ||
		(input.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && input.SurfaceClassification != "project") ||
		!validPracticeLearningActionDigest(input.TaskRevisionDigest) || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() ||
		(input.LearningPathID != "" && !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.LearningPathID)) {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || len(targets) == 0 {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if target.Version == "" {
			return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	payload := struct {
		StudentID             string              `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID        string              `json:"task_instance_id"`
		Schema                string              `json:"schema"`
		TaskRevisionID        string              `json:"task_revision_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest    string              `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		SurfaceClassification string              `json:"surface_classification"`
		LearningTargets       []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
		LearningPathID        string              `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		LearningActionID      string              `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
		LearningPathItemID    string              `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
		RequirementID         string              `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	}{input.StudentID, input.TaskInstanceID, input.Schema, input.TaskRevisionID, input.TaskRevisionDigest, input.SurfaceClassification, input.LearningTargets, input.LearningPathID, "", input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID}
	if input.LearningActionIDExplicit {
		payload.LearningActionID = input.LearningActionID
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return PracticeLearningActionReserve{}, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	input.EnsureRequestHash = hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(input PracticeLearningActionBinding) (PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	if !validLessonCorrelationPair(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) {
		return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest)
	input.SurfaceClassification = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SurfaceClassification))
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.CancelReason = strings.TrimSpace(input.CancelReason)
	if input.OpenedAt != nil {
		value := input.OpenedAt.UTC()
		input.OpenedAt = &value
	}
	if input.ClosedAt != nil {
		value := input.ClosedAt.UTC()
		input.ClosedAt = &value
	}
	if input.Schema != StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.LearningActionID) ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.StudentID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validPracticeLearningActionDigest(input.TaskRevisionDigest) ||
		(input.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && input.SurfaceClassification != "project") ||
		(input.LearningPathID != "" && (!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.LearningPathID) || input.LearningPathVersionReservation < 1 || input.LearningPathPositionReservation < 0)) ||
		(input.LearningPathID == "" && (input.LearningPathVersionReservation != 0 || input.LearningPathPositionReservation != 0)) {
		return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || len(targets) == 0 {
		return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if target.Version == "" {
			return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	switch input.LifecycleStatus {
	case PracticeLearningActionReserved:
		if input.OpenedAt != nil || input.ClosedAt != nil || input.CancelReason != "" {
			return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case PracticeLearningActionOpen:
		if input.OpenedAt == nil || input.OpenedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedAt != nil || input.CancelReason != "" {
			return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case PracticeLearningActionCancelled:
		if input.ClosedAt == nil || input.ClosedAt.IsZero() || !IsPracticeLearningActionCancelReason(input.CancelReason) ||
			(input.OpenedAt != nil && input.ClosedAt.Before(*input.OpenedAt)) {
			return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case PracticeLearningActionClosed:
		if input.OpenedAt == nil || input.OpenedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedAt == nil || input.ClosedAt.IsZero() ||
			input.ClosedAt.Before(*input.OpenedAt) || input.CancelReason != "" {
			return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

// PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2 is the strict, public result envelope
// for a previously reserved Student-owned Practice action. It intentionally
// excludes validation output, workspace contents and evaluation material.
type PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2 struct {
	LearningPathItemID      string                       `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID           string                       `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	Schema                  string                       `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID              string                       `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID        string                       `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID               string                       `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID          string                       `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID          string                       `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest      string                       `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	WorkspaceDigest         string                       `json:"workspace_digest"`
	SubmissionID            string                       `json:"submission_id"`
	Outcome                 string                       `json:"outcome"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string                       `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
	HintsUsed               int                          `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int                         `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                         `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
	Evidence                []PracticeCompetencyEvidence `json:"evidence"`
	OccurredAt              time.Time                    `json:"occurred_at"`
	PolicyVersion           string                       `json:"policy_version"`
	RequestHash             string                       `json:"-"`
}

type PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2 struct {
	Schema           string `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID       string `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID string `json:"learning_action_id"`
	Accepted         bool   `json:"accepted"`
	PolicyVersion    string `json:"policy_version"`
}

func NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, taskInstanceID, idempotencyKey string, input PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2) (PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2, error) {
	if !validLessonCorrelationPair(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	// v2 is a wire contract: UUIDs and digests must already be canonical, not
	// merely normalizable. This keeps idempotency/hash identities unambiguous.
	if input.EvidenceID != strings.TrimSpace(input.EvidenceID) || input.LearningActionID != strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID) ||
		input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID) || input.TaskInstanceID != strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		input.TaskRevisionID != strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID) || input.TaskRevisionDigest != strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest) ||
		input.WorkspaceDigest != strings.TrimSpace(input.WorkspaceDigest) || input.SubmissionID != strings.TrimSpace(input.SubmissionID) ||
		studentID != strings.TrimSpace(studentID) || taskInstanceID != strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID) || idempotencyKey != strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey) {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.EvidenceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EvidenceID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest)
	input.WorkspaceDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.WorkspaceDigest)
	input.SubmissionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SubmissionID)
	input.Outcome = strings.TrimSpace(input.Outcome)
	input.AssistancePolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.AssistancePolicyVersion)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	studentID, taskInstanceID, idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID), strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()
	if input.Schema != PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2 || input.PolicyVersion != PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2 ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) || input.StudentID != studentID ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(taskInstanceID) || input.TaskInstanceID != taskInstanceID ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.EvidenceID) || idempotencyKey != input.EvidenceID ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.LearningActionID == input.EvidenceID ||
		!IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(input.SubmissionID) ||
		input.SubmissionID != input.EvidenceID || !validPracticeLearningActionDigest(input.TaskRevisionDigest) ||
		!validPracticeLearningActionDigest(input.WorkspaceDigest) || input.Outcome != "passed" ||
		input.AssistancePolicyVersion == "" || len(input.AssistancePolicyVersion) > 64 || input.HintsUsed < 0 || input.HintsUsed > 1000 ||
		input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || len(input.Evidence) == 0 || len(input.Evidence) > 100 {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	if (input.HintsUsed == 0) != (input.MaxHintLevel == nil) || input.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*input.MaxHintLevel < 1 || *input.MaxHintLevel > 7) {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Evidence))
	for index := range input.Evidence {
		item := &input.Evidence[index]
		target, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(item.Target)
		if err != nil || target.Version == "" || item.Correctness < 0 || item.Correctness > 1 || item.Independence < 0 || item.Independence > 1 || item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 || len(item.StepIDs) == 0 || len(item.StepIDs) > 100 {
			return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
		}
		item.Target = target
		identity := targetIdentity(target)
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
		}
		stepSeen := map[string]struct{}{}
		for stepIndex := range item.StepIDs {
			item.StepIDs[stepIndex] = strings.TrimSpace(item.StepIDs[stepIndex])
			if item.StepIDs[stepIndex] == "" || len(item.StepIDs[stepIndex]) > 128 {
				return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
			}
			if _, duplicate := stepSeen[item.StepIDs[stepIndex]]; duplicate {
				return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, ErrEvidenceContract
			}
			stepSeen[item.StepIDs[stepIndex]] = struct{}{}
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	payload := struct {
		StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
		TaskInstanceID string `json:"task_instance_id"`
		PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2
	}{StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: taskInstanceID, PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2: input}
	payload.RequestHash = ""
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{}, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	input.RequestHash = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	return input, nil
}

func PracticeEvidenceReducerInputsV2(input PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2) ([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, error) {
	if input.RequestHash == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("normalized practice evidence is required")
	}
	support := TeacherSupportIndependent
	if input.HintsUsed > 0 || input.TeacherAssistanceUsed {
		support = TeacherSupportGuided
	}
	kind, err := deriveTargetEvidenceKind(LearningEvidenceApplication, LearningActionPassed, support)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]LearningActionTargetEvidence, 0, len(input.Evidence))
	for _, item := range input.Evidence {
		result = append(result, LearningActionTargetEvidence{LearningActionID: input.LearningActionID, StudentID: input.StudentID,
			TaskID: input.TaskInstanceID, Target: item.Target, EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication, Outcome: LearningActionPassed,
			SupportContext: support, Kind: kind, HintsUsed: input.HintsUsed, MaxHintLevel: input.MaxHintLevel,
			InterventionUsed: input.TeacherAssistanceUsed, TeacherPolicyVersion: input.AssistancePolicyVersion,
			MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion, OccurredAt: input.OccurredAt})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func PracticeLearningTargetsOrderedEqual(left, right []LearningTargetRef) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index].Type != right[index].Type || left[index].Key != right[index].Key || left[index].Version != right[index].Version {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validPracticeLearningActionDigest(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 {
		return false
	}
	if value != strings.ToLower(value) {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
}

func IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func PracticeLearningTargetIdentitySetEqual(left, right []LearningTargetRef) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	set := make(map[string]struct{}, len(left))
	for _, target := range left {
		set[string(target.Type)+"\x00"+target.Key+"\x00"+target.Version] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, target := range right {
		if _, exists := set[string(target.Type)+"\x00"+target.Key+"\x00"+target.Version]; !exists {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validLessonCorrelationPair(item, requirement string) bool {
	return item == "" && requirement == "" || IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(item) && IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(requirement)
}
